implementation: Helion Fast SHA-256 Hashing IP Core
description: The Helion Fast Hash core implements the NIST approved SHA-256 secure hash algorithm to FIPS 180-4. These are high performance cores that have been designed specifically for use in ASIC. The hash algorithm takes as input a message of arbitrary length, process the message as a series of 512 or 1024 bit blocks, and produce as output a 256bit compressed representation of the message data in the form of a message digest,
